description: Room Impulse Response and Noise Database (annotations). No recipe reads it. The annotations are the room and noise lists inside a 1.3 GB archive of recordings, more than a fetch holds in memory (see https://github.com/Mearman/keepset/issues/212). The option-list parser reads the lists, so the size is all that remains.
